name: Galadriel
subtitle: Lady of the Golden Wood
game_text:
At the start of each of your turns, you may heal an Elf.
<phase>Fellowship</phase>: Exert Galadriel to play the fellowship’s next site if it is a forest (replacing opponent’s site if necessary).
flavor_text: “‘There is in her and in this land no evil, unless a man bring it hither himself. Then let him beware!’”
